prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, rainy outside, bright soft daylight through the windows with warm interior fill.
Image 1: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S1
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Lin Qingyu stands soaked in the open space in front of the walnut desk, with the closed office door behind him. He is sweating and stiff. Ji Ran stands facing him at arm's length on the desk side of him, with her arms folded. Xu Banxia is gone. The camera stays on the lounge-area side.
Panel 1: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Lin Qingyu's shoulder, eye-level, from the lounge-area side. Past Lin Qingyu's wet shoulder, Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk with her arms folded and nods once.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, low angle, locked-off camera, on Lin Qingyu. Lin Qingyu straightens up to his full height and squares his shoulders.
Panel 3: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran's eyes flick up and down his body.
Panel 4: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu from the lounge-area side. Lin Qingyu wipes the sweat from his forehead with the back of his hand.
Panel 5: Medium close-up, slight push in, eye-level, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran tilts her head and narrows her eyes.
Panel 6: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu's face. Lin Qingyu flashes a hopeful, boyish smile.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran in front of the walnut desk. Ji Ran's shoulders drop as she lets out a long, disappointed sigh and unfolds her arms.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, low angle, locked-off camera, on Ji Ran. Ji Ran, deadpan, points one finger past Lin Qingyu toward the office door.
Panel 9: Close-up, quick push in, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu's face. Lin Qingyu's jaw drops and his eyes widen in disbelief.
Panel 10: Wide shot, slow pull out, eye-level, from the lounge-area side. Lin Qingyu stands frozen in front of the desk with the office door behind him. Ji Ran turns away toward the walnut desk as the image softens into drifting, glowing light.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
